standard.summary: Vortex 是 R&D 级的显存管理策略，通过智能调度 GPU 和 CPU 之间的数据流动来优化显存利用率。
standard.effect: vortex_strategy 控制调度策略（standard）。vortex_profile 控制激进度（standard/low_vram/extreme）。
standard.whenToUse: 标准显存优化手段都不够时的最后选择。R&D 特性，稳定性待验证。
standard.avoidWhen: 生产训练中不建议使用。可能影响训练结果的可复现性。

standard_en.summary: Vortex is an R&D-grade VRAM management strategy that optimises memory use by scheduling the data flow between GPU and CPU intelligently.
standard_en.effect: vortex_strategy controls the scheduling strategy (standard). vortex_profile controls how aggressive it is (standard/low_vram/extreme).
standard_en.whenToUse: The last resort when none of the standard VRAM optimisations is enough. An R&D feature, with stability yet to be confirmed.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Inadvisable in production training. It may affect the reproducibility of training results.

advanced.principle: Vortex 动态分析模型各部分的显存使用模式（计算密集 vs 内存密集），自动决定哪些部分应该常驻 GPU、哪些应该流式交换。low_vram profile 更激进的交换，extreme profile 可能导致性能大幅下降但显存需求最低。
advanced.intervention: 在训练循环中注入显存管理调度器，动态调整数据驻留策略。
advanced.expectedImpact: extreme profile 可将显存需求降低 40-60%，但速度损失 30-50%。
advanced.tradeoffs: vortex_profile 选择决定显存/速度的权衡。

advanced_en.principle: Vortex dynamically analyzes each model part's VRAM usage pattern (compute-intensive vs memory-intensive) and automatically decides which parts should stay resident on GPU and which should be streamed/swapped. The low_vram profile swaps more aggressively; the extreme profile may hurt performance substantially but has the lowest VRAM requirement.
advanced_en.intervention: Injects a VRAM management scheduler into the training loop, dynamically adjusting data residency strategy.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: The extreme profile can lower VRAM needs by 40-60% at a 30-50% speed cost.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The vortex_profile choice is the VRAM/speed trade-off.
